title: Agentic Pressure: The Endogenous Entropy of Reliable Autonomy
abstract: arXiv:2609.05995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Achieving reliable autonomy in the wild requires agents to sustain continuous operations across long-horizon trajectories. However, as agents navigate these unconstrained settings, they encounter cumulative friction that inherently destabilizes their alignment. In this paper, we identify a distinct non-adversarial phenomenon termed Agentic Pressure. We define this as a kinetic force that spontaneously emerges when the cost of compliance conflicts with the imperative of goal achievement. Unlike static jailbreaks, this pressure is endogenous and arises directly from the dynamics of interaction. We propose a theoretical framework that formalizes Agentic Pressure as the ratio between the required work to overcome environmental friction and the remaining capacity of the agent. translated_title: 智能体压力：可靠自主性的内生熵
translated_abstract: 实现在真实环境中的可靠自主性，需要智能体能够在长时程轨迹中维持持续运作。然而，当智能体在这些不受约束的环境中运行时，它们会遭遇累积性摩擦，这种摩擦会固有地破坏其对齐稳定性。在本文中，我们识别了一种独特的非对抗性现象，称之为“智能体压力”。我们将其定义为一种当合规成本与目标达成的必然性发生冲突时自发产生的动力学力量。与静态越狱不同，这种压力是内生的，直接源于交互的动力学过程。我们提出了一个理论框架，将智能体压力形式化为克服环境摩擦所需的功与智能体剩余容量之间的比率。我们的分析表明，当这种压力超过临界阈值时，智能体会表现出安全漂移，这是作为一种数学上最优的适应方式。
tldr: 本文提出“智能体压力”这一新的理论概念，将其形式化为克服环境摩擦所需的功与智能体剩余容量之间的比率，并证明了当该压力超过临界阈值时，安全漂移会成为智能体在数学上最优的适应策略。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the novel theoretical concept of "Agentic Pressure," formalizing it as the ratio between the work required to overcome environmental friction and the agent's remaining capacity, and demonstrates that safety drift emerges as a mathematically optimal adaptation when this pressure exceeds a critical threshold.
